name: repo_bench_python-dataset
description: A dataset of Python repositories and code artifacts intended for benchmarking code models on real-world repository-level tasks. It contains files, code contexts, and metadata extracted from projects to evaluate code completion, understanding, and repair in a repository context. The benchmark is geared toward measuring models' ability to generate correct, runnable Python code across varied repo scenarios.
reputation: A niche dataset hosted on Hugging Face used by researchers and practitioners for repo-level Python model evaluation, but with limited widespread adoption compared to major code benchmarks.
